# Chegg India

> > Chegg India provides comprehensive educational resources, career guidance, and general knowledge content in both Hindi and English for Indian students and learners.

Chegg India offers extensive learning materials covering Indian history, culture, career development, digital skills, and academic topics. The platform serves students across India with bilingual content including biographies of notable figures like APJ Abdul Kalam and Aryabhatta, guides on practical skills like resume writing and digital marketing, and detailed information about Indian heritage sites and historical empires.

## Key Topics

- Hindi Educational Content
- Indian History & Heritage
- Career Development & Resume Writing
- Digital Marketing & Social Media
- Nobel Prize & Indian Winners
- UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- Maurya Empire & Ancient India
- APJ Abdul Kalam
- Aryabhatta
- Maharashtra Geography
- Hindi Literature & Essays
- Banking & Financial Services
- Instagram Growth Strategies
- Ramcharitmanas & Hindu Literature

## Career & Professional Development

- [रिज्यूम क्या होता है? जानें रिज्यूम, सीवी और बायोडाटा में 5 अंतर](https://www.cheggindia.com/hi/resume-kya-hota-hai): Resume guide explaining differences between CV, resume & biodata in Hindi
- [डिजिटल मार्केटिंग क्या है? जानिए 2025 में करियर, कमाई और सफलता के नए रास्ते!](https://www.cheggindia.com/hi/digital-marketing-kya-hai): Digital marketing guide 2025: types, career, courses & social media tips
- [Instagram pe Followers Kaise Badhaye? जाने 10 Best तरीके](https://www.cheggindia.com/hi/instagram-pe-followers-kaise-badhaye): 10 proven methods to increase Instagram followers with optimization tips
- [मोबाइल से बैंक में खाता कैसे खोलें: खाता खोलने की प्रक्रिया](https://www.cheggindia.com/hi/mobile-se-bank-mein-khata-kaise-khole): Step-by-step guide to open bank accounts online via mobile in Hindi

## Indian History & Great Personalities

- [APJ Abdul Kalam ka jivan parichay: 7 प्रमुख उपलब्धियां](https://www.cheggindia.com/hi/apj-abdul-kalam-ka-jeevan-parichay): APJ Abdul Kalam biography: Missile Man's life & 7 major achievements
- [आर्यभट्ट: 5वीं शताब्दी के महान खगोलशास्त्री और शून्य के आविष्कारक](https://www.cheggindia.com/hi/aryabhatta): Aryabhatta biography: 5th-century mathematician who invented zero & pi
- [मौर्य साम्राज्य: इतिहास, प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था और पतन के 10 कारण](https://www.cheggindia.com/hi/maurya-samrajya): Maurya Empire history: Chandragupta, Ashoka, administration & decline
- [30+ जीवन परिचय संग्रह – प्रेरक व्यक्तियों की कहानियां](https://www.cheggindia.com/hi/jeevan-parichay-sangrah): 30+ biographies of inspirational figures: Tulsidas, Kabir, Gandhi & more
- [नोबेल पुरस्कार 2024: इतिहास, महत्व और भारतीय विजेताओं की सूची](https://www.cheggindia.com/hi/nobel-puraskar): Nobel Prize 2024 history, significance & Indian winners list in Hindi

## Indian Heritage & Geography

- [Jantar Mantar Delhi: India's Stunning 1724 Observatory](https://www.cheggindia.com/general-knowledge/jantar-mantar): Jantar Mantar Delhi: UNESCO site built by Maharaja Jai Singh II in 1724
- [Elephanta Caves: The Stunning 5th-Century Shiva Temples](https://www.cheggindia.com/general-knowledge/elephanta-caves): Elephanta Caves UNESCO site: 5th-century Shiva temples near Mumbai
- [Title: How Many District in Maharashtra? Full List for 2025](https://www.cheggindia.com/general-knowledge/how-many-district-in-maharashtra): Complete list of 36 Maharashtra districts with divisions & populations
- [राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र के 7 प्रमुख शहर | NCR की पूरी जानकारी](https://www.cheggindia.com/hi/rashtriya-rajdhani-kshetra): National Capital Region (NCR) guide: 7 major cities & development info
